business_problem: Farm Credit Canada (FCC), an agricultural and food lending corporation in Canada, sought to boost employee productivity, enhance customer service, and stay at the forefront of technology adoption in the sector.
solution_summary: Farm Credit Canada used Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure to surface grounded answers from enterprise knowledge faster. Farm Credit Canada (FCC), an agricultural and food lending corporation in Canada, sought to boost employee productivity, enhance customer service, and stay at the forefront of technology adoption in the sector. Key implementation elements included Microsoft 365 Copilot applies AI to documents, meetings, mail, and other everyday knowledge work; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Microsoft Azure hosts the application, data, and integrations on scalable cloud infrastructure; Microsoft 365 provides the documents, messages, and meetings that feed user workflows. Enterprise content from documents, meetings, websites, or internal systems is passed through retrieval and model services so users receive grounded answers inside the target workflow.
